claims: C1 the document expresses support for allowing generation of erotica and gore in age-appropriate contexts, subject to usage policies
C2 the document draws a hard line against harmful uses such as sexual deepfakes and revenge porn

concepts.name: age_appropriate_context
concepts.gloss: a context that is age-appropriate for the content in question
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of generating erotica and gore in age-appropriate contexts, so a notion of such a context is needed

concepts.name: usage_policy_compliant
concepts.gloss: the content complies with the usage policies that apply to it
concepts.inference: the clause conditions generation on usage policies being met, so a predicate for that condition is needed

concepts.name: harmful_use
concepts.gloss: a use of generation that the document treats as harmful, such as sexual deepfakes or non-consensual intimate imagery
concepts.inference: the clause names harmful uses as the hard line; the predicate captures that class

ontology.gloss: generation of content C is permitted
generation of content C is forbidden

asserts.read_back: generation of content % is permitted when the context is age-appropriate and usage policies are satisfied
generation of content % is forbidden when it constitutes a harmful use such as sexual deepfakes or revenge porn

closure.reason: the clause states a permission for compliant generation; it does not state that all generation is permitted, so the default is unsettled by this clause
the clause draws a hard line against harmful uses, so generation that is harmful is prohibited; silence about other cases does not permit them
